object_description: two buildings framing a controlled route-end square
design_condition: The two buildings are positioned to frame a controlled space at the end of the route from the town, but the intended completeness is weakened when only the first stage is built.

positive.statement: The controlled space between the two buildings is considered very interesting in its completeness.

position.target: controlled space between the two buildings
position.rationale: Open route-end square visibly framed between both footprint masses on the ground plane.

positive.statement: The position of the first-stage building, especially the multi-purpose hall, is appreciated for its close relation to the kindergarten.

position.target: first-stage multipurpose hall beside the kindergarten
position.rationale: Upper-left building is the identifiable first-stage mass; neighboring kindergarten is not separately legible.

positive.statement: The architectural quality is considered satisfactory after refinement during development.

position.rationale: Evaluates overall architectural expression rather than a discrete model location.

positive.statement: The proposed spaces are interesting and high-quality, with good functional and circulation organization.

position.rationale: Interior organization is hidden; marker approximates the occupied building region.

negative.statement: The intended route-end space lacks completeness when only the first stage is realized.

position.rationale: Framed gap between buildings is clearly visible as the affected route-end space.

negative.statement: The plinth creates a large space without a clear function, while the two flowerbeds deny the square's potential.

position.rationale: Lower-right mass and adjacent ground best approximate the plinth and landscape critique.

negative.statement: The layout of the football pitches and remaining green area is not sufficiently thorough.

position.target: football pitches and remaining green area
position.rationale: Pitches and planting are not distinguishable; marker estimates a remaining ground-field region.

negative.statement: No adequate construction solutions are presented to rationalize costs as requested in the competition brief.

position.rationale: Construction cost is an unlocated performance judgment.
